text: The major is designed to train professionals with computer hardware, software and applications, computer communications, and other aspects of the basic theory , who are expertise in computer research and application development, computer teaching, computer communications network engineering design and development, operational management and maintenance in the units such as scientific research, education, the executive departments, the information industry and government. The major is a brand field of the university. It is making great efforts to take talents training as the basis, and sound systems as the foundation, by constantly innovating. It is trying to form interdisciplinary, giving full play to the advantage of communication of the university.
